# Voxen Insights

Voxen Insights publishes practical Korean-language articles about applying data engineering, AI automation, trend analysis, APIs, dashboards, and business systems to real business growth.

## Core business topics
- Data collection and data engineering
- AI automation and AI agents
- Business workflow mapping and FDE delivery
- Business dashboards and APIs
- Sales, marketing and operational automation
- Custom software systems for business workflows

## Latest Articles
- ["그거 누구한테 말하면 돼요?" 사내 IT·총무 요청, 아직 메신저로 받고 계신가요? 사내 요청 접수·처리 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/internal-request-helpdesk-automation/): A practical guide to automating internal IT and office service requests: understanding why requests for broken printers, account permissions, supplies and facility repairs get lost when they arrive through personal messengers, hallway conversations and email, listing request types with the information each one needs, a default owner, a backup owner and an agreed target handling time, keeping the messenger or groupware employees already use as the entry point while collecting every request into one numbered list with requester, type, owner, status and resolution, assigning owners with fixed rules and using AI only to turn free-text requests into form fields, ask for missing details and surface similar past cases or internal guides, never letting AI finalize permission grants, security reports or requests that cost money, notifying requesters on every status change and escalating overdue requests to backup owners or managers, and using accumulated request data to build FAQs, fix repeat equipment problems and bundle onboarding and offboarding requests.
- [제안요청서(RFP) 100쪽, 요구사항 표로 옮기는 데 며칠 걸리시나요? RFP 요구사항 추출·대응표 작성 AI 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/rfp-requirement-extraction-automation/): A practical guide to automating requirement extraction from requests for proposal (RFPs): understanding why requirements scattered across the body, annexes, evaluation tables and submission forms get missed when people copy them by hand, converting PDFs and attachments into structured text with page and section locations, having AI extract each requirement, eligibility condition, evaluation item, deadline and form with its source location and a confidence flag, building a requirement traceability matrix with ID, type, mandatory level, owner, response section and compliance status, routing low-confidence items, ambiguous wording and contract or legal clauses to human review and experts, reflecting addenda and Q&A answers as versioned changes, and reusing the matrix as the pre-submission checklist and as a record for the next bid.
- [ERP 바꾸면서 옛 데이터는 엑셀로 옮겨 붙이면 되나요? 시스템 교체 시 데이터 이관(마이그레이션) 검증 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/system-migration-data-validation/): A practical guide to validating data migration when replacing ERP, CRM or other business systems: understanding why record counts can match while meanings, codes, truncated values, broken relationships, revived statuses and lost history still go wrong, deciding migration scope separately for master data, open transactions, completed history and aggregates while documenting what will not be moved and confirming retention obligations with accounting and tax experts, writing a field-level mapping specification with conversion rules, defaults, length limits and an old-to-new ID table that business owners approve, verifying in four layers of counts, sums and distributions, deliberately chosen samples and real business scenarios against a pre-agreed list of report figures that must match, running at least two full rehearsals with an announced input freeze before cutover and keeping the old system read-only until the first month-end close has been compared, and using AI only to propose field mappings, code conversion tables and exception summaries while value conversion stays in rule-based scripts confirmed by people.
- [경쟁사 사업보고서, 분기마다 PDF로 내려받아 직접 읽고 계신가요? 전자공시(DART) 데이터로 경쟁사·거래처 동향 모니터링 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/dart-disclosure-competitor-monitoring/): A practical guide to monitoring competitors and business partners with Korean electronic disclosure (DART) data: understanding what periodic reports, material event reports, exchange filings, audit reports and shareholding filings reveal and when they appear, noting that non-listed companies subject to external audit also publish audit reports, retrieving filings and structured financial figures through the Open DART API within its daily limits and terms instead of scraping, mapping target companies to corporate codes and defining which filing types to watch per competitor, supplier, customer and potential entrant, collecting daily and alerting only on changes with immediate alerts for audit opinion changes, rehabilitation filings and supply contracts, using AI only to summarize narrative sections with source locations and extract contract fields while taking all financial numbers from the structured API, and leaving credit decisions and accounting or legal interpretation to responsible managers and experts.
- [반품 하나 들어오면 택배·재고·환불 담당자가 따로 움직이시나요? 반품·교환·환불 처리 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/return-exchange-processing-automation/): A practical guide to automating product returns, exchanges and refunds: understanding why one return request pulls in customer service, logistics, warehouse, accounting and shipping staff who each work in separate screens, creating a single returns ledger that links every case to the original order with type, reason code, pickup tracking number, inspection result, decision, refund amount, stock disposition and status timestamps, running every case through one flow of intake, eligibility check, pickup booking, receipt and inspection, decision, refund or reshipment, stock update and customer notification, auto-approving only standard in-policy cases and automatic refunds only after a passed inspection while routing high-value, repeated, damaged or out-of-stock exchange cases to people, calculating refund amounts with a written rules table for shipping fee deductions and coupon restoration, confirming consumer protection return conditions and B2B contract terms with legal experts before entering them as rules, using AI only to map free-text return reasons to a fixed reason code table, and using accumulated return data to fix product pages, packaging and process bottlenecks.
- [상담 100건 중 몇 건이나 직접 들어보고 평가하시나요? 고객 상담 품질 평가(QA) AI 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/customer-service-qa-scoring-automation/): A practical guide to automating customer service quality assurance (QA) scoring: understanding why sampling a few calls per agent per month misses most problems and judges agents inconsistently, turning unwritten evaluator judgment into a written scorecard with items, criteria, weights, examples and non-applicable rules, converting calls and chats into text with speaker separation and masking personal data before any AI step, having AI score every interaction only against that scorecard with quoted evidence for each item and an explicit "cannot judge" option, routing low-confidence scores, failed critical items, customer complaints and disagreements plus a monthly random sample to human reviewers, feeding confirmed results back as coaching notes, process fixes and scorecard revisions, reviewing recording consent and employee monitoring rules with HR and legal experts before rollout, and tracking agent-vs-AI agreement rate to decide how far to trust the automated scores.
- [공급가 오를 때마다 ERP·견적서·쇼핑몰 단가 따로 고치고 계신가요? 판매 단가표 변경 반영 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/price-list-update-automation/): A practical guide to automating sales price list updates: understanding why one supplier price change has to be re-entered in ERP, quote templates, online stores and customer-specific price sheets, building a single price master with item code, customer group, currency, effective start and end dates, base price, pricing rule, approver and change reason, running changes through a flow of request, impact calculation, approval, scheduled application to each system, verification and notification, recalculating derived prices with fixed rules while leaving margin policy and customer-specific exceptions to people, deciding in advance how open quotes and unshipped orders are handled, keeping original and prior prices with history, and using AI only to extract price change notices from supplier emails and PDFs for human confirmation.
- [같은 부품인데 코드가 세 개라면? 품목·SKU 마스터 데이터 표준화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/product-master-data-standardization/): A practical guide to standardizing product and SKU master data: understanding how the same item ends up with different codes across purchasing, production, sales and e-commerce systems, deciding what counts as one item before merging, defining mandatory master fields such as representative code, name, specification, base unit, packaging unit and barcode, preserving original codes in a mapping table instead of overwriting them, splitting AI matching suggestions from human confirmation, and adding a registration gate and periodic checks so codes do not drift apart again.
- [경쟁사 신제품, 출시 뉴스 보고서야 알게 되셨나요? 특허·상표 공개 데이터로 경쟁사 동향 모니터링 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/patent-trademark-data-competitor-monitoring/): A practical guide to monitoring competitor activity with public patent and trademark data: understanding what patents, designs and trademarks reveal and when they become public, retrieving Korean filing data from KIPRIS and the KIPRIS Plus Open API within terms of use instead of scraping, defining monitoring criteria by applicant name variants, IPC/CPC classification codes, trademark classes and keywords, collecting weekly and alerting only on new filings and status changes such as publication, registration, rejection or lapse, using AI only to summarize specifications with source locations and suggest product-area tags marked as estimates, leaving infringement and validity judgments to patent attorneys, and treating filings as signals rather than confirmed launches alongside news and price data.
- [견적서 세 장 받아서 엑셀에 다시 옮겨 적고 계신가요? 거래처 견적서 비교·검토 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/vendor-quote-comparison-automation/): A practical guide to automating vendor quote comparison: defining the comparison fields every quote must be mapped to such as internal item code, quantity, unit, unit price, VAT treatment, delivery date, validity period, side costs and payment terms, collecting quotes per request from email attachments, PDFs, spreadsheets and messengers, using OCR and AI only to extract fields with source location and confidence, normalizing units, currency and VAT with fixed rules while keeping original values, recalculating totals to verify extraction, routing low-confidence fields, ambiguous item matches, conditional wording and missing fields to human review, handing the confirmed comparison table into the purchase approval flow, and building quote history to track unit price trends, vendor response speed and quote-to-invoice gaps, with vendor selection left to people.
